_note: What the web posts to the gateway for a file from Skola24 (Formatbeskrivare, X3). `file` is a synthetic table as Skola24's page for the staff import describes it (eight columns, no header row, the last the confidential mark); `body` is what web/lib reads out of it: the description skola24-personal-csv, X2's applyMapping with the rows the mark holds back left out, and the teachers' mapper. web/lib/skola24-posts.test.ts REGENERATES `body` from `file` and requires equality; test/import-skola24.e2e-spec.ts posts `body` through the real pipe, controller and ImportService. Change one side and the other fails. `teachersTf` is the same kind of file in the form Skola24's own course files have: TF numbers (ÅÅÅÅMMDDTFnn) in the ID column, and 0 or empty in the confidential mark.
